source: Exact v19 source-qualified individual-provider contract cohort; licensed gpurentalprices first eligible daily capture
cohort: Reuse deterministic frozen source cohort and source vintage rules from the unchanged v19 protocol; new study IDs, no competition-target identity claim
unavailable_arm: Expanded is excluded by a deterministic effective-protocol lock only if its preregistered data gate failed before training; no invented model or unflagged persistence substitute
model_lock: Freeze operational selected checkpoints, full categorical support, renderer/tokenizer, prepared input hashes and source-code hashes before first eligible issuance
primary_comparison: Development-selected eligible continuation arm versus frozen incumbent; exact ties retain incumbent. No operational seed selection using retrospective or future results.
secondary_comparisons: expanded versus same-data continuation when both are available
all available arms versus unchanged official drift
1/3-day pinball, median MAE, coverage, width and failures
information_cutoff: Origin end UTC; issue within60minutes thereafter, before compatible target observations mature
truth: First retained compatible target-day source capture; preserve missingness and revisions
publication: Exact full probability vectors and quantiles committed with verified signed Sigstore publication timestamps, never author-entered dates alone

analysis.interim: Descriptive issuance/status only; no promotion before final analysis
analysis.paired: Seven-day mean dollar pinball on identical eligible source contracts, origin-block sensitivity lengths2/4,2000resamples,seed20261117
analysis.dependence: Shared market origins and contracts, overlapping horizons and all ordering seeds remain dependent. Reusing the v19 cohort is a matched comparison, not independent replication.
analysis.positive_claim: At fixed analysis, primary continuation must have negative paired loss versus incumbent and upper paired block95% bounds below zero in both sensitivities, no higher failure rate, and a complete compatible registered panel. Otherwise retain incumbent and report negative/inconclusive. Approximate block intervals are not a coverage guarantee.
analysis.data_claim: A separate expanded-minus-same comparison is required; a continuation gain alone does not establish a benefit from more data.
analysis.stopping: 16 registered weekly origins; no extension until success, no future retuning or automatic promotion

preserved_panels: All existing panels, including November23 gate, v18 December6/February1 and v19/v20 December20/April12, remain unchanged
